cues.en: As I said, CNNs are very computationally intensive.
cues.zh: 如前所述，CNN 非常耗費運算。

cues.en: They are very heavy on your CPU, your GPU, and your memory requirements.
cues.zh: 對 CPU、GPU 與記憶體，都有很大負擔。

cues.en: Shuffling all that data around and convolving it adds up really, really fast.
cues.zh: 搬動這些資料、做卷積，成本很快累積。

cues.en: Beyond that, there's a lot of what we call "hyperparameters" a lot of different knobs and dials that you can adjust on CNNs.
cues.zh: 除此之外，CNN 有很多所謂超參數，也就是各種可調整的旋鈕。

cues.en: So in addition to the usual stuff, you can tune the topology of your neural network or whatever optimizer you use or what loss function you use or what activation function you use.
cues.zh: 除了平常的選項，例如神經網路拓樸、最佳化器、損失函數或激活函數，

cues.en: There are also choices to make about the kernel sizes, that is the area that you actually convolve across, how many layers do you have, how many units do you have, and how much pooling do you do when you're reducing
cues.zh: 還得選擇核心大小，也就是實際卷積的區域、層數、單元數，以及縮減影像時，要做多少

cues.en: the image down.
cues.zh: 池化。

cues.en: There's a lot of variance here.
cues.zh: 變化很多。

cues.en: There are almost an infinite amount of possibilities for configuring a CNN.
cues.zh: CNN 設定的可能性，幾乎無限。

cues.en: But often, just obtaining the data to train your CNN is the hardest part.
cues.zh: 但通常，取得 CNN 訓練資料，才是最難的部分。

cues.en: So for example, if you own a Tesla car, that's actually taking pictures of the world around you and the road around you and all the street signs and traffic lights as you drive.
cues.zh: 例如，如果你有 Tesla，開車時，它其實會拍攝周圍世界、道路、路標與紅綠燈。

cues.en: Every night, it sends all those images back to some data server somewhere so Tesla can actually run training on its own neural network based on that data.
cues.zh: 每天晚上，將所有影像傳回某個資料伺服器，讓 Tesla 能根據資料，訓練自己的神經網路。

cues.en: So if you slam on the brakes while you're driving a Tesla, at night, that information is going to be fed into a big data center somewhere and Tesla is going to crunch on that and say,
cues.zh: 因此，開 Tesla 時如果猛踩煞車，晚上資訊就送進某個大型資料中心，Tesla 會處理並問：

cues.en: "hey is there a pattern here to be learned from what I saw from the cameras from the car?
cues.zh: 「從車輛攝影機看到的內容，是否有某種模式可學，

cues.en: That means you should slam on the brakes".
cues.zh: 代表應該猛踩煞車？」

cues.en: When you think about the scope of that problem, just a sheer magnitude of processing and obtaining an analyzing all that data, that becomes very challenging in and of itself.
cues.zh: 想想這個問題的規模，光是處理、取得、分析所有資料的龐大數量，本身就很有挑戰。

cues.en: Fortunately, the problem of tuning the parameters doesn't have to be as hard as I described it to be.
cues.zh: 幸好，調整參數，不一定像剛才描述那麼難。

cues.en: There are specialized architectures of convolutional neural networks that do some of that work for you.
cues.zh: 有些專門的卷積神經網路架構，替你做部分工作。

cues.en: A lot of research goes into trying to find the optimal topologies and parameters for a CNN for a given type of problem.
cues.zh: 很多研究，都在為特定問題，尋找 CNN 最佳拓樸與參數。

cues.en: And you can just think of this like a library you can draw from.
cues.zh: 可以把它想成能取用的函式庫。

cues.en: So for example, there's the LeNet-5 architecture that you can use that's suitable for handwriting recognition in particular.
cues.zh: 例如 LeNet-5 架構，特別適合手寫辨識。

cues.en: There's also one called AlexNet, which is appropriate for image classification.
cues.zh: 也有 AlexNet，適合影像分類。

cues.en: It's a deeper neural network than LeNet.
cues.zh: 它比 LeNet 更深。

cues.en: In the example we talked about on the previous slides, we only had a single hidden layer, but you can have as many as you want.
cues.zh: 前面投影片的範例，只有單一隱藏層，但其實想要幾層都可以。

cues.en: It's just a matter of how much computational power you have available.
cues.zh: 只取決於有多少運算能力。

cues.en: There's also something called GoogleLeNet, you can probably guess who came up with that, it's even deeper, but it has better performance because it introduces this concept called inception modules.
cues.zh: 還有 GoogLeNet，大概猜得出是誰提出的。它更深，但效能更好，因為引入 Inception 模組。

cues.en: Inception modules group convolution layers together.
cues.zh: Inception 模組，將卷積層組合起來。

cues.en: And that's a useful optimization for how it all works.
cues.zh: 這對整體運作，是有用的最佳化。

cues.en: Finally, the most sophisticated one today is called ResNet, that stands for Residual Network.
cues.zh: 最後，目前最精密的叫做 ResNet，也就是殘差網路。

cues.en: It's an even deeper neural network but it maintains performance by what's called "skip connections".
cues.zh: 網路更深，但透過所謂的跳接，維持效能。

cues.en: It has special connections between the layers of the perceptron to further accelerate things, so it builds upon the fundamental architecture of a neural network to optimize its performance.
cues.zh: 它在感知器各層間加入特殊連線，進一步加速，因此在神經網路基本架構上，最佳化效能。

cues.en: And as you'll see, CNNs can be very demanding on performance.
cues.zh: 你會看到，CNN 對效能要求很高。
